Spec2Tests Sample Specification: User Account Management
==========================================================

1. Introduction
----------------
This document describes the functional requirements for the user account
management module of the Spec2Tests platform. It is intended to be used as
a realistic, on-disk fixture for automated tests that exercise the plain
text extraction pipeline end to end.

2. Functional Requirements
---------------------------
2.1 Registration
The system shall allow a new user to register an account by providing a
unique email address and a password that is at least eight characters long.
If the supplied email address is already registered, the system shall
reject the registration attempt and display a clear validation error
message to the user.

2.2 Login
The system shall allow a registered user to log in using their email
address and password. If the credentials are invalid, the system shall
display an authentication error message and shall not grant access to any
protected resource.

2.3 Password Reset
The system shall allow a user who has forgotten their password to request
a password reset link via email. The reset link shall expire after 24
hours. Attempting to use an expired or already-used reset link shall
result in a clear error message instructing the user to request a new
link.

2.4 Account Lockout
The system shall temporarily lock an account for 15 minutes after five
consecutive failed login attempts, in order to mitigate brute-force
credential guessing attacks.

3. Non-Functional Requirements
--------------------------------
3.1 The login endpoint shall respond within 500 milliseconds under normal
load conditions.
3.2 All passwords shall be stored using a salted, one-way cryptographic
hash; plaintext passwords shall never be persisted or logged.

4. Out of Scope
-----------------
Single sign-on (SSO) integration with third-party identity providers is
explicitly out of scope for this specification and will be addressed in a
future revision.
